Lower Mary Hill homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Lower Mary Hill, September 2026. Detached houses: 11 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 18% (a balanced market). No condos and townhomes were listed or sold in Lower Mary Hill between June and September.

Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Lower Mary Hill?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in Lower Mary Hill. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Lower Mary Hill a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 18% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Lower Mary Hill from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 11 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in Lower Mary Hill over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in July with 4 sold.

faq.q: How big is Lower Mary Hill compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Lower Mary Hill held 7.2% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Lower Mary Hill than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 14 to 11 (−21.4%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
